components.text: The [color=yellow]Fuel Refinery [color]is a machine that is used to used to refine [ref=stellaris:items/oil]oil[ref].

[br][br]How to use : [br]Place the fuel refinery next to an electricity source. Then you can input oil that will be refined into fuel and diesel. [br][br]Stats : [br]- Power Consumption : 100 FE/t [br]- Oil Consumption : 1000 mB/t [br]- Fuel Production : 500 mB/t [br]- Diesel Production : 500 mB/t
